# Dreaming Electric Sheep (DES)

> High-performance CPython 3.13+ serving stack built on Granian RSGI.

## Summary
Dreaming Electric Sheep (`des`) is a web framework for CPython >= 3.13 that runs on Granian RSGI by default. It provides startup-compiled `msgspec.Struct` parameter binders, automated OpenAPI 3.0 documentation (Scalar / Swagger / ReDoc), and a developer CLI (`des why`, `des routes`, `des doctor`) to inspect the compiled request pipeline.

## Installation
```bash
pip install "dreaming-electric-sheep[standard]"
```

## Quick Start
```python
from des import Application, get, post
from msgspec import Struct

class Item(Struct):
    name: str
    price: float

app = Application()

@get("/hello")
def hello():
    return {"message": "Hello from DES!"}

@post("/items")
def create_item(item: Item):
    return {"status": "created", "item": item}
```

## CLI
- `des new <name> -t api`: Scaffold REST API with Scalar docs and Struct validation.
- `des dev`: Start Granian RSGI development server with reload.
- `des run app:app --workers 4`: Start Granian RSGI production server.
- `des why POST /items`: Inspect compiled route match and binders.
- `des check`: Validate routes and configuration.
- `des routes`: Print compiled radix routing table.
- `des doctor`: Inspect C-core acceleration and runtime health.
